rows: Devanagari for Hindi: systematic, ~3-4 weeks to read. Nastaliq for Urdu: harder, cursive.
Ergative split in perfective tense — verb agrees with object, not subject
Honorific pronoun system (3 levels, each with different verb forms)
Always end sentences with the verb: "I coffee want" not "I want coffee"
Must learn gender of every noun (no reliable rules for invariable nouns)
Hindi works in North India; South India (Tamil Nadu, Kerala) prefers English
Urdu is official; regional languages (Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto) dominate locally
